name: Corinthia Rome
insider_take: Where Imperial Rome meets modern grandeur — the Corinthia Rome is a palace reborn, breathing new life into one of the Eternal City's most storied addresses.
whats_special: Housed in a magnificently restored 19th-century palazzo near the Piazza della Repubblica, the Corinthia Rome debuted in 2023 as one of Italy's most anticipated luxury openings. The hotel sits steps from the ancient Baths of Diocletian and Rome's iconic Termini district, yet wraps guests in an atmosphere of intimate, palatial elegance. Its interiors masterfully blend neoclassical Roman architecture with contemporary Italian craftsmanship, featuring hand-selected artworks and bespoke furnishings that pay homage to Rome's artistic heritage.
pro_tip: Request a room facing the internal courtyard for a tranquil retreat from Rome's buzzing streets — a serene secret garden feel right in the heart of the city.
dont_miss: Indulge in the hotel's rooftop experience, offering sweeping panoramic views across Rome's breathtaking skyline — ancient domes and terracotta rooftops stretching as far as the eye can see. Also explore the signature spa and wellness offerings, a true sanctuary designed to channel the ancient Roman tradition of restorative bathing culture.
pros: Historic grand hotel with stunning neoclassical architecture
Prime location near major Roman attractions and shopping
Award-winning ESPA spa with authentic Roman thermal baths
Exceptional dining experiences with rooftop terrace views
cons: Historic building may have smaller room configurations
